Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa (Zimmermann Salesforce PWA Kit). This is a planning-only task — do not write any code, just produce a detailed design. I'm in Claude Code's Plan Mode; your output will feed directly into a plan file I present to the developer (Marcel) for approval before any implementation happens.

## The ask
Marcel wants a full overhaul of the Storybook stories for the `ZimmProductCard` organism (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/`). Today there are TWO separate story surfaces:
1. `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx` — title `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard'`, 8 curated named-export stories.
2. `zimmProductCard/nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` — title `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard/Coverage'` (a nested sub-category), 12 stories organized strictly by Figma node ID (`{Home,PLP,Wishlist}_{Desktop,Mobile}_{Default,Unavailable}`) plus 1 explicit "excluded, not in scope" placeholder (`Hero_ExcludedNotInScope`).

His exact words: "let's scratch all the current stories we have both in the ZimmProductCard and Coverage and then rebuild the ZimmProductCard folder to contain all the relevant stories as per the ACs that are guided by both the designs and the comments; this is so that instead of having ZimmProductCard and its stories with also the Coverage folder and its stories we can have a single collection of stories that are driven by the variants and states guided by the ACs, designs, and comments."

So: delete `nodeCoverage/` entirely, delete the current `index.stories.tsx` content, and rebuild ONE consolidated story file, organized by real product variant/state (not Figma node ID), covering everything the AC/Figma/comments actually require — no more, no less.

## Confirmed safe/isolated
Grepped the whole repo (`overrides/`, `.storybook/`): the ONLY references to `nodeCoverage` anywhere are two self-referential JSDoc comments, one in each of the two story files, pointing at each other. No test file in that folder, no `.storybook` config reference, nothing else imports it. Deleting the whole `nodeCoverage/` folder is fully isolated — confirmed, not assumed.

## The component's full contract (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.tsx`, 476 lines)

Discriminated union on `variation: 'home' | 'plp' | 'wishlist'`:
- **Base props** (all variations): `id`, `href`, `name`, `headingLevel`, `primaryImage`, `hoverImage?`, `images?`, `currentPrice?`, `originalPrice?`, `isPriceLoading?`, `isUnavailable?`, `onNotifyMe?`, `badge?`.
- **`plp` adds**: `onAddToBag?`, `sizeChipValues?`, `selectedSizeChipValue?`, `onSizeChipSelect?`.
- **`wishlist` adds**: `colour` (required), `size` (required), `onRemove` (required), plus the same `onAddToBag?`/`sizeChipValues?`/`selectedSizeChipValue?`/`onSizeChipSelect?` trio as plp.
- **`home` adds nothing.**

Full `VARIATION_CONFIG` (11 boolean flags, verbatim, no others exist):
| Flag | home | plp | wishlist |
|---|---|---|---|
| showBag | false | true | true |
| showAttributes | false | false | true |
| showSizeChips | false | true | true |
| hoverHidesPrice | false | true | true |
| hoverRevealsPrice | true | false | false |
| hoverRevealsSizeSelector | false | true | true |
| showRemove | false | false | true |
| hideBagOnMobile | false | true | false |
| hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable | false | false | true |
| showBadge | false | true | true |
| showHoverImageSwap | false | true | true |

Derived logic in the component body: `showNotifyMe = isUnavailable && onNotifyMe` (variation-agnostic); `hoverHidesPrice/hoverRevealsSizeSelector` gated `&& !isUnavailable`; `sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && isUnavailable` (permanently hides size-chip wrapper, both hover states, every device, when true); `bagHiddenOnMobile = hideBagOnMobile || (hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && isUnavailable)`; `resolvedBadge = showBadge ? badge : undefined`. No `switch(variation)` anywhere — 100% table-driven. Carousel-vs-single-image is decided entirely by the child `ZimmProductCardMedia` based on `images.length`, not by this organism.

Load-bearing caveat straight from the shipped docblock (keep this alive in whatever replaces the `Wishlist` story's own JSDoc): Wishlist's `hoverRevealsSizeSelector:true` is **NOT stated in the Jira AC** (AC only mentions the image-swap+arrows for Wishlist hover) — it shipped matching the Figma design anyway, "a judgment call made during implementation, not a conflict that was raised on the ticket or separately ratified." Don't silently drop this caveat when the story gets rewritten.

## Current `index.stories.tsx` — 8 existing named exports (title `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard'`, decorator: `MemoryRouter` + fixed `Box width="320px"`, NO `play` function anywhere — deliberate, docblocks say "manual visual check")
| Export | variation | isUnavailable | badge | image mode | price | size chips |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Default` | plp | — | 'Runway' | primaryImage+hoverImage (2-image swap, no images[] array) | currentPrice only | sizeChipValues=SIZES, unselected |
| `PLPOutOfStock` | plp (spreads Default) | true | inherited | inherited | inherited | inherited; adds onNotifyMe |
| `Home` | home | — | 'Runway' (passed but suppressed by showBadge:false — deliberately proves suppression) | primaryImage+hoverImage (swap suppressed by showHoverImageSwap:false) | currentPrice only | n/a |
| `HomeOutOfStock` | home (spreads Home) | true | inherited | inherited | inherited | n/a; adds onNotifyMe |
| `Wishlist` | wishlist | — | 'Runway' | primaryImage+hoverImage | currentPrice only | sizeChipValues=SIZES, pre-selected 'm' matching size:'M'; also colour:'Ivory', size:'M', onRemove, onAddToBag |
| `WishlistOutOfStock` | wishlist (spreads Wishlist) | true | inherited | inherited | inherited | inherited; adds onNotifyMe |
| `SingleImage` | plp (spreads Default) | — | inherited | hoverImage:undefined, images:undefined — forces ONE static image, no swap, no carousel | inherited | inherited |
| `MultipleImages` | plp (spreads Default) | — | inherited | hoverImage:undefined, images:GALLERY_IMAGES (3 real images: primary/hover-look/back-view) — real carousel with arrows | inherited | inherited |

A local (not exported) `LiveSizeSelectionCard` wrapper is used by every plp/wishlist story so a chip click visually re-selects — this exact same helper is ALSO duplicated byte-for-byte in `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx`; once that folder is deleted only one copy remains, naturally deduplicating.

## Confirmed gaps — states that exist in the real component/AC but have ZERO organism-level story today
1. **Was/Now (sale) pricing** — `originalPrice` set alongside `currentPrice` switches to "Was {X} Now {Y}" display (PRC-09, generic atom-level behavior, already shipped, works identically for any variation — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx`). Confirmed via grep of every organism-level story export: none set `originalPrice`. The sibling molecule `zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx` already has its own `WithSalePrice` story demonstrating this at that layer.
   **CRITICAL — do not confuse with a different, unimplemented concept**: there is a separate, Wishlist/CRM-specific "What's Now" price type mentioned in a still-open PRD item (`.docs/prd/account.md:186-190`) that was explicitly investigated and found NOT built anywhere in the shipped diff. Generic Was/Now (build a story for this) ≠ CRM "What's Now" (do NOT build a story implying this exists — no code path for it).
2. **One Size** — `values.length === 1` renders a single non-interactive `<span>`, not a radiogroup (`zimmSizeChipGroup`, Figma node `40003066:34866`). Only PLP and Wishlist ever show size chips at all (Home never does). No organism-level "OneSize" story exists — it only exists today at the `ZimmSizeChipGroup` and `ZimmProductCardContent` layers, both of which already have their own `OneSize`/`WithSizeChipsOneSize`/`WithAttributesOneSize` stories as precedent for how to name/shape this.
3. **Price loading** — `isPriceLoading?: boolean` is a real, wired prop (forwarded straight through to `ZimmProductCardContent`), and the sibling `zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx` already has its own `LoadingPrice` story as precedent — but no organism-level story sets `isPriceLoading: true` anywhere today. (I found this myself by reading the prop contract directly — it wasn't called out by name in the project's own build-audit docs the way gaps 1 and 2 were, so treat it as slightly lower-confidence than those two, worth flagging as a proposal rather than a certainty.)

## Explicitly NOT relevant — do not build stories implying these are supported (all confirmed via direct source reading, not assumption)
- **Recently-Viewed carousel badge/hover-swap suppression** — a real, named Jira comment requirement (Dani Rivett: "we do not want the badge displayed on the Homepage **or** on the Recently Viewed product carousel" / "...or the recently viewed carousel" for the hover action) that has **NO code path today** — there is no `'recently-viewed'` union member, and the closest a rail consumer could reach for (`variation: 'plp'`) gets the OPPOSITE of what was asked (badge/hover-swap both ON). This is SFCC-83's future, unbuilt work. The gap is already documented in `index.tsx`'s own docblock. Do not invent a story for it.
- **The orphaned "Hero" variant** — Figma nodes `40004599:89265`/`40004638:120484`, confirmed to have no owning Jira ticket at all (SFCC-81/218/882 all ruled out by direct reading). `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` currently keeps this documented as an explicit `Hero_ExcludedNotInScope` placeholder story (custom static JSX, renders no real `ZimmProductCard` instance at all) specifically so the reason for its absence isn't lost. Once `nodeCoverage/` is deleted, **this specific piece of documentation has nowhere else to live** unless it's preserved somehow (e.g. a docblock note in the new consolidated file) — everything else in the "not relevant" list already has a permanent home in `index.tsx`'s/other files' own source docblocks and doesn't need re-documenting here.
- Stock Status Badge (Available/Unavailable/Low stock) — not built, no AC.
- Clickable/interactive badge — explicitly "do not implement" per `.docs/prd/plp.md:70`.
- VIC/customer-group price precedence — deferred to a separate ticket (SFCC-778).
- Whole-card loading/empty skeleton state (no image/name/price at all yet, before any data arrives) — explicitly owned by a different ticket (SFCC-80), not this component. (Distinct from gap #3 above, which is a real wired prop for just the price sub-element.)
- Region-unavailable greyed state, destructive add-to-bag repurposing (Wishlist) — investigated, not found in the shipped diff.

## House style precedent (sibling files — same "one file, many descriptive named exports, no coverage subfolder" pattern, confirmed as the norm elsewhere in this codebase, `nodeCoverage/` is a one-off unique to this component)
- `molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx`: `Default`, `WithSalePrice`, `WithAttributes`, `WithAttributesOneSize`, `WithSizeChips`, `WithSizeChipsOneSize`, `Unavailable`, `LoadingPrice`.
- `molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.stories.tsx`: `Default`, `WithSelection`, `WithDisabledSize`, `OneSize`, `KeyboardNavigation` (this one has the file's only `play` function, testing arrow-key nav).

## Project conventions that constrain the design (already-loaded rules, quote-accurate)
From `.claude/rules/components.md` (Storybook section): "Required for any component exported from its folder... Pages get a story showing the full assembly with representative props — not a story per sub-section." / "Add named exports for meaningful states... not for every possible prop combination." / "play functions only when there's interactive behaviour worth asserting; otherwise the story is purely visual."

## What I need from you
Produce a concrete, executable design for the single rebuilt `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx` (replacing both current files/folders). Specifically:

1. **The final named-export list** — validate or refine my working hypothesis of keeping all 8 existing stories (they each map to a real, distinct, AC/Figma-backed state — variation × availability × image-count) and adding exactly 3 new ones for the 3 confirmed gaps (a Was/Now sale-price story, a OneSize story, a price-loading story) = 11 total. Tell me if you think any of the 8 existing ones is actually redundant once the other 10 exist, or if I'm missing a distinct state the AC/Figma findings above imply but I haven't named.
2. **Exact prop values / args** for each of the 3 new stories — which base story should each extend (spread `.args` from), and what needs to change. Be specific (e.g. for OneSize: which variation, what `sizeChipValues` shape, does it need the `LiveSizeSelectionCard` wrapper or not given a one-size chip is non-interactive).
3. **Where the "Hero orphan" documentation should live** now that its only home (`nodeCoverage`) is being deleted — I'm leaning toward a short docblock note at the top of the consolidated file (not a fake story) rather than inventing a story for a variation with no real code path. Confirm or propose better.
4. **File-level structure** — meta config (title stays `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard'`?), decorators (keep the fixed 320px width + MemoryRouter?), whether `LiveSizeSelectionCard` needs any change now that it's no longer duplicated, and where the Wishlist-hover-size-selector-is-not-AC-stated caveat and any other load-bearing docblock caveats from the current file should land in the rewritten version so nothing gets silently lost in the rewrite.
5. **Vitest/type-check impact** — confirm whether `index.test.tsx` (983 lines, tests the component directly, not the stories) has any dependency on story exports that would break, and whether deleting `nodeCoverage/` requires any other file changes (tsconfig, storybook config, etc.) — I already confirmed via grep that nothing outside the two story files' own JSDoc references `nodeCoverage`, so this should just be a "confirm nothing else needed" check, not new investigation.

Do not investigate further yourself unless something above is genuinely ambiguous from what's given — I've already done the exploration; I need this synthesized into a concrete build spec I can put in front of the developer for approval. Output should be structured (tables/lists), not narrative prose.

213	   *  real Figma Wishlist Hover instance (node 40002187:58458) during the SFCC-236 Step 6 visual
214	   *  audit that Wishlist's hover reveal is a genuine, populated size-selector swap identical to
215	   *  PLP's — not a PLP-only affordance. `index.tsx`'s render body already forwarded these
216	   *  unconditionally to `ZimmProductCardContent` for every variation (via the
217	   *  `ZimmProductCardVariationFields` cast below); this type previously just didn't expose them
218	   *  to a Wishlist caller, which is what let the Wishlist story ship without ever populating them. */
219	  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[];
220	  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
221	  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;
222	};
223	
224	export type ZimmProductCardProps = ZimmProductCardBaseProps &
225	  (ZimmProductCardPlpVariation | ZimmProductCardHomeVariation | ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation);
226	
227	type ZimmProductCardVariation =
228	  | ZimmProductCardPlpVariation['variation']
229	  | ZimmProductCardHomeVariation['variation']
230	  | ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation['variation'];
231	
232	/**
233	 * Widened, not narrowed: every variation-specific field is optional here regardless of which
234	 * branch is actually active, purely so the component body below can destructure once with no
235	 * `if`/`switch` on `props.variation` — the extensibility AC requires every layout/visibility
236	 * decision to come from `VARIATION_CONFIG`, keyed by the discriminant, never a branching
237	 * statement. The exported `ZimmProductCardProps` discriminated union above is what actually
238	 * enforces correct usage at every call site (proven by the `@ts-expect-error` cases in
239	 * index.test.tsx) — this cast only relaxes internal access inside this file; it changes nothing
240	 * about what a caller may legally pass in.
241	 */
242	type ZimmProductCardVariationFields = Partial<
243	  Omit<ZimmProductCardPlpVariation, 'variation'> &
244	    Omit<ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation, 'variation'> &
245	    Omit<ZimmProductCardHomeVariation, 'variation'>
246	>;
247	
248	type ZimmProductCardVariationConfig = {
249	  showBag: boolean;
250	  showAttributes: boolean;
251	  showSizeChips: boolean;
252	  /** PLP/Wishlist: price is visible by default and hides on hover. */
253	  hoverHidesPrice: boolean;
254	  /** Home only: price is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
255	  hoverRevealsPrice: boolean;
256	  /** PLP/Wishlist: the size-chip picker is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
257	  hoverRevealsSizeSelector: boolean;
258	  showRemove: boolean;
259	  /** PLP only (found during the SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): Figma's Mobile Card-content
260	   *  instance has the bag icon's `Icons` frame `hidden="true"`, unlike Desktop and unlike
261	   *  Wishlist's own Mobile instance (bag stays visible there on every breakpoint). A viewport-
262	   *  width concern, not a hover one — see zimmProductCard.css.ts's own responsive rule. */
263	  hideBagOnMobile: boolean;
264	  /** Wishlist only (found during the follow-up full-sweep visual audit against every variant x
265	   *  state node): unlike PLP's unconditional `hideBagOnMobile`, Wishlist's Mobile Card-content
266	   *  instance shows the bag icon when available (`40002187:58470`) and hides it
267	   *  (`Icons` frame `hidden="true"`) only when unavailable (`40002187:58473`) — narrower than
268	   *  `hideBagOnMobile`, and combined with it (not replacing it) in the `bagHiddenOnMobile`
269	   *  derivation below, since the two are mutually exclusive per variation today but there is no
270	   *  reason to assume that stays true forever. */
271	  hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: boolean;
272	  /** Shown on PLP/Wishlist, suppressed on Home — see the module docblock's "Badge" note. */
273	  showBadge: boolean;
274	  /**
275	   * Allows `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s primary/hover image crossfade for this variation. Suppressed
276	   * on Home per Dani Rivett's scope note, overriding the AC's unconditional framing — see the
277	   * module docblock's "Hover image-swap on Home" note. `false` here means a supplied
278	   * `hoverImage` is simply never swapped to, regardless of pointer capability.
279	   */
280	  showHoverImageSwap: boolean;
281	};
282	
283	/**
284	 * The extensibility AC's actual mechanism: every layout/visibility decision this organism makes
285	 * reads from this table, keyed by `variation` — adding a future variation means adding a union
286	 * member above and one row here, touching no JSX. `index.tsx`'s render body contains no
287	 * `switch`/`if` on `props.variation` anywhere (verify with
288	 * `grep -n 'variation ===\|switch (variation)' index.tsx` — zero hits).
289	 */
290	const VARIATION_CONFIG: Record<ZimmProductCardVariation, ZimmProductCardVariationConfig> = {
291	  home: {
292	    showBag: false,
293	    showAttributes: false,
294	    showSizeChips: false,
295	    hoverHidesPrice: false,
296	    hoverRevealsPrice: true,
297	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
298	    showRemove: false,
299	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
300	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
301	    showBadge: false,
302	    showHoverImageSwap: false,
303	  },
304	  plp: {
305	    showBag: true,
306	    showAttributes: false,
307	    showSizeChips: true,
308	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
309	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
310	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
311	    showRemove: false,
312	    hideBagOnMobile: true,
313	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
314	    showBadge: true,
315	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
316	  },
317	  wishlist: {
318	    showBag: true,
319	    showAttributes: true,
320	    showSizeChips: true,
321	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
322	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
323	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
324	    showRemove: true,
325	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
326	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: true,
327	    showBadge: true,
328	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
329	  },
330	};
331	
332	const messages = defineMessages({
333	  // Interpolated with the product name, matching ZimmProductPrice's WAS/NOW pattern — Media's
334	  // own `removeLabel` prop is a plain string, so the interpolation happens here, at the one call
335	  // site that actually knows the product name.
336	  removeFromWishlist: {
337	    id: 'product_card.remove.from_wishlist',
338	    defaultMessage: 'Remove {name} from wishlist',
339	  },
340	});
341	
342	const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCard';
343	
344	/**
345	 * Organism — the full product card, composing `ZimmProductCardMedia` and `ZimmProductCardContent`
346	 * across the `home` / `plp` / `wishlist` variations. See the module docblock above for the
347	 * confirmed Figma variation matrix and this component's own recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) for
348	 * the stretched-link and hover-reveal mechanics that live entirely in CSS, not in this render
349	 * body — both children are always rendered in full, with every one of their own sub-parts; CSS
350	 * alone decides what is visible for a given variation and pointer capability.
351	 *
352	 * @param props see `ZimmProductCardProps` — a discriminated union on `variation`.
353	 */
354	export const ZimmProductCard = (props: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
355	  const {
356	    id,
357	    href,
358	    name,
359	    headingLevel,
360	    primaryImage,
361	    hoverImage,
362	    images,
363	    currentPrice,
364	    originalPrice,
365	    isPriceLoading,
366	    isUnavailable,
367	    onNotifyMe,
368	    badge,
369	    variation,
370	  } = props;
371	
372	  const { onAddToBag, sizeChipValues, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect, colour, size, onRemove } =
373	    props as ZimmProductCardVariationFields;
374	
375	  const intl = useIntl();
376	  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];
377	
378	  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
379	  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
380	  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
381	  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
382	
383	  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
384	  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
385	  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
386	  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
387	  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
388	  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
389	  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
390	  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
391	  //
392	  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
393	  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
394	  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
395	  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
396	  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
397	  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
398	  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
399	  //
400	  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
401	  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
402	  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
403	  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
404	  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
405	  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean
406	  // for both the size-chip permanent-hide and this new price rule, since both only ever apply to
407	  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
408	  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
409	  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
410	  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);
411	
412	  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
413	  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
414	  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing
415	  // both conditions to the recipe — it only needs to know "hide this on mobile for this render",
416	  // not why.
417	  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));
418	
419	  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;
420	  const resolvedBadge = config.showBadge ? badge : undefined;
421	
422	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE, {
423	    hoverHidesPrice,
424	    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
425	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
426	    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
427	    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,
428	    // revealed on hover/focus-visible — every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference shows it
429	    // appearing only there) but unconditionally visible on touch (every Mobile Unavailable
430	    // reference — the only state a touch pointer ever sees, per the "Mobile has no Hover variant"
431	    // finding — shows it plainly, with no hover to reveal it). This flag is deliberately keyed off
432	    // `showNotifyMe` itself, not `variation`: the confirmed behaviour is identical across all
433	    // three variations, and the recipe's selector simply matches nothing when notify-me isn't
434	    // mounted at all.
435	    hoverRevealsNotifyMe: showNotifyMe,
436	    hideBagOnMobile: bagHiddenOnMobile,
437	  });
438	
439	  return (
440	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-card" data-product-id={id}>
441	      <ZimmProductCardMedia
442	        primaryImage={primaryImage}
443	        hoverImage={hoverImage}
444	        images={images}
445	        swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
446	        showControls
447	        badge={resolvedBadge}
448	        onRemove={onRemove}
449	        removeLabel={removeLabel}
450	      />
451	      <ZimmProductCardContent
452	        name={name}
453	        headingLevel={headingLevel}
454	        href={href}
455	        currentPrice={currentPrice}
456	        originalPrice={originalPrice}
457	        isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
458	        showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
459	        colour={colour}
460	        size={size}
461	        showBag={config.showBag}
462	        isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
463	        onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
464	        showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
465	        sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
466	        selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
467	        onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
468	        showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
469	        onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
470	      />
471	    </chakra.div>
472	  );
473	};
474	
475	export default ZimmProductCard;
476

38	/**

40	 * confirmed Home/PLP/Wishlist variation matrix (Product-card component set, node `40000223:2822`,
41	 * file `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm`) this story file is responsible for demonstrating. Hero variants
42	 * (`40004599:*`, `40004638:*`) are out of scope — no ticket claims them (see this component's own
43	 * module docblock). Mobile has no Hover state at all, so 12 stories below cover all 18 in-scope
44	 * nodes — each Desktop story's own manual hover demonstrates its Hover node; each story's own
45	 * docblock states exactly which node(s) it stands for.

48	 *              Default          Hover            Mobile (no Hover state exists)
49	 *   Home       40000214:6141    40002163:36593   40000223:2821  (Unavailable: 40002163:39999)
50	 *   PLP        40002163:41441   40002163:41459   40002163:41477 (Unavailable: 40002163:41486)
51	 *   Wishlist   40002187:58446   40002187:58458   40002187:58470 (Unavailable: 40002187:58473)

54	 * `40002163:41450`/`:41468` · Wishlist `40002187:58452`/`:58464`.
55	 *
56	 * Mobile behaviour is a real `@media (min-width: 48em)` **viewport** query
57	 * (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`'s `DESKTOP_QUERY`), not a container query — this file's own 320px
58	 * decorator `Box` below cannot trigger it. Every mobile claim in this file's story docblocks was
59	 * live-verified in a real browser at a genuine 375px viewport (2026-09-04), not just read off
60	 * Figma — resize the actual browser/preview pane below 768px to reproduce.

62	const meta: Meta<typeof ZimmProductCard> = {

64	  component: ZimmProductCard,
65	  parameters: { layout: 'padded' },
66	  decorators: [
67	    // The composed ZimmProductCardContent renders a real react-router-dom <Link>, which requires

84	/**
85	 * Wraps `ZimmProductCard` so `selectedSizeChipValue` is genuinely live rather than a static arg —
86	 * neither `ZimmProductCard` nor the `ZimmSizeChipGroup` it composes tracks selection itself (both
87	 * are correctly controlled components), so any story that wants a chip click to visually select
88	 * must own that state itself, the same pattern zimmSizeChipGroup/index.stories.tsx's
89	 * `KeyboardNavigation` story already uses via its own `KeyboardNavigationExample`. Originally
90	 * `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx`'s own `DefaultExample`, moved here so every enabled-size-chip
91	 * story across both `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx` and
92	 * `zimmProductCard/nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` can share one implementation instead of each
93	 * retyping it. Every arg passes straight through unchanged; only
94	 * `selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect` become live. `onSizeChipSelectFromArgs` still fires
95	 * the original `args.onSizeChipSelect` (each story's own `fn()` spy) so Storybook's Actions panel
96	 * keeps logging the click.
97	 *
98	 * `onSizeChipSelect`/`selectedSizeChipValue` only exist on the `plp`/`wishlist` members of
99	 * `ZimmProductCardProps`'s discriminated union (see zimmProductCard/index.tsx) — `home` has
100	 * neither. Narrowing via the `variation` discriminant into a single `propsWithLiveSelection`
101	 * value (rather than spreading `args` and adding those two as separate attributes) matters for
102	 * real, not just style: once
103	 * narrowed, `{...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect}` is a proper subtype of the
104	 * `plp`/`wishlist` branch and assigns cleanly to the wider union; attaching the same two
105	 * attributes directly on top of an unnarrowed `{...args}` spread does NOT — TypeScript distributes
106	 * that spread per union branch and rejects them on the `home` branch, unlike the lenient "excess
107	 * property on any one member" behaviour `index.test.tsx` documents for a plain object-literal
108	 * assignment (confirmed the hard way in this component's original `DefaultExample` draft: `npx
109	 * tsc --noEmit` correctly rejected it).
110	 */
111	const LiveSizeSelectionCard = (args: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
112	  // Lazy initializer: seeds from args.selectedSizeChipValue once on mount only, never re-syncs on rerender.
113	  const [selectedSizeChipValue, setSelectedSizeChipValue] = useState<string | undefined>(() =>
114	    args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist' ? args.selectedSizeChipValue : undefined,
115	  );
116	  const isSizeChipVariation = args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist';
117	  const onSizeChipSelectFromArgs = isSizeChipVariation ? args.onSizeChipSelect : undefined;
118	  const handleSizeChipSelect = (value: string) => {
119	    setSelectedSizeChipValue(value);
120	    onSizeChipSelectFromArgs?.(value);
121	  };
122	  const propsWithLiveSelection: ZimmProductCardProps = isSizeChipVariation
123	    ? { ...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect: handleSizeChipSelect }
124	    : args;
125	  return <ZimmProductCard {...propsWithLiveSelection} />;
126	};

128	/**
129	 * PLP-shaped baseline — also this file's mandatory `Default` export (per
130	 * .claude/rules/components.md's Storybook conventions), so there is no separately-named `PLP`

135	 * zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx's `MultipleImages` story documents. No `play` function

137	 * confirmed shown on PLP by SFCC-236's own real AC (`customfield_10231`), not just Dani Rivett's
138	 * scope note.
139	 *
140	 * Resize below the tablet breakpoint to also check Fix D: the bag icon is hidden unconditionally
141	 * on mobile PLP, regardless of stock status — unlike Wishlist, where the same hide is conditional
142	 * on being unavailable (see `WishlistOutOfStock` below). Live-verified at a real 375px viewport
143	 * (2026-09-04): `[data-card-slot="bag"]` computed `display: none`.
144	 *
145	 * Size chips are genuinely interactive here, not a static snapshot — starts with nothing selected;
146	 * click a chip to see it visually select. Rendered via `LiveSizeSelectionCard` above, which owns
147	 * `selectedSizeChipValue` as local state; every other arg below is unchanged.
148	 *
149	 * Figma nodes: Default `40002163:41441` · Hover `40002163:41459` · Mobile `40002163:41477`.
150	 */
151	export const Default: Story = {
152	  args: {
153	    id: 'prod-1',
154	    variation: 'plp',
155	    name: 'Natura Long Sleeve Linen Mini Dress',
156	    headingLevel: 'h3',
157	    href: '/product/123',
158	    primaryImage: PRIMARY_IMAGE,
159	    hoverImage: HOVER_IMAGE,
160	    currentPrice: '$595.00',
161	    badge: 'Runway',
162	    onAddToBag: fn(),
163	    sizeChipValues: SIZES,

167	};

171	 * Hover to confirm the size-selector swap still behaves exactly like the in-stock PLP card above
172	 * (`Default`) — unlike `HomeOutOfStock` below, where price stays visible alongside notify-me
173	 * rather than being replaced (see index.tsx's own Fix F docblock note for why PLP/Wishlist and
174	 * Home genuinely differ here).
175	 *
176	 * Resize below the tablet breakpoint to also check Fix D (bag unconditionally hidden, same as
177	 * `Default` above) AND Fix F (mobile-only): unlike desktop's additive treatment (price stays,
178	 * notify-me simply added), mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable genuinely SWAPS price for notify-me.
179	 * Live-verified at a real 375px viewport (2026-09-04): bag `display: none`, price
180	 * `display: none`, notify-me `display: block`.
181	 *
182	 * Figma nodes: Default `40002163:41450` · Hover `40002163:41468` · Mobile `40002163:41486`.
183	 */
184	export const PLPOutOfStock: Story = {
185	  args: {
186	    ...Default.args,
187	    variation: 'plp',
188	    isUnavailable: true,
189	    onNotifyMe: fn(),
190	  },
191	  render: (args) => <LiveSizeSelectionCard {...args} />,

194	/**
195	 * Home card: image + name only by default — no bag, no attributes, no size chips at all. Hover
196	 * the card to reveal the price, the one variation where price is hidden until hover rather than
197	 * visible-by-default. Manual visual check only, same Storybook hover-media-context limitation as

## Storybook

Storybook is the canonical place to view components in isolation. Keep it browsable —
a flat 200-story sidebar is unusable.

### When a story is required

- **Required** for any component exported from its folder under `overrides/app/components/`
  or `overrides/app/pages/` (i.e. anything another file imports).
- **Not required** for purely internal sub-components that only render inside one parent
  (e.g. `productTile/priceRow.tsx` used only by `productTile/index.tsx`). Cover their
  variants via the parent's stories.
- Pages get a story showing the full assembly with representative props — not a story per
  sub-section.

### Categorisation

Story `title` drives the sidebar tree. Pick the first matching category:

| Category      | What goes here                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Foundation/` | Design tokens — Colour, Typography, Spacing, Icons, Shadows                                                                                                                                         |
| `Elements/`   | Generic building blocks — both display (Badge, Tag, Link, Avatar, Skeleton) and interactive controls (Button, Input, Checkbox, Select). Tiebreaker: _can it be used outside a form?_ → `Elements/`. |
| `Layout/`     | Global chrome, navigation, and structural components — Header, Footer, DrawerMenu, ListMenu, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Seo                                                                            |
| `Commerce/`   | Commerce-specific shared components — ProductTile, OrderSummary, PromoCode, DisplayPrice, SwatchGroup                                                                                               |
| `Forms/`      | Composed form assemblies — AddressForm, CheckoutContactForm, NewsletterSignup                                                                                                                       |
| `Pages/`      | Full page assemblies — PDP, PLP, Cart, Checkout, Account                                                                                                                                            |
| `Contentful/` | CMS-driven components — HeroBanner, RichText, ContentBlock. Use mock Contentful data in stories so variants are visible without a live CMS connection.                                              |

Naming convention: singular for a concept or proper noun (`Foundation`, `Commerce`, `Layout`, `Contentful`); plural for a collection (`Elements`, `Forms`, `Pages`).

Examples:

```ts
export default { title: 'Commerce/ProductTile' }; // ✅
export default { title: 'Layout/Header' }; // ✅
export default { title: 'Elements/Button' }; // ✅
export default { title: 'Pages/PDP' }; // ✅
export default { title: 'Elements/DisplayPrice' }; // ❌ — eCommerce specific, use Commerce/
export default { title: 'Primitives/Button' }; // ❌ — use Elements/
```

When in doubt: ask "what does this component _know_ about?" Commerce → `Commerce/`,
CMS-driven → `Contentful/`, nothing domain-specific → `Elements/`, page-level composition → `Pages/`.

### Story content

- Every story file has a `Default` named export.
- Add named exports for meaningful states (`Loading`, `OutOfStock`, `WithDiscount`) — not
  for every possible prop combination.
- `play` functions only when there's interactive behaviour worth asserting; otherwise the
  story is purely visual.
